description: This file implements the WatchConnectivityReceiver class, which manages communication between an iOS app and a WatchOS app using WatchConnectivity. It includes data structures for sending replies and results, handles session activation, message transmission, and processing incoming messages with parsing and normalization functions.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: A class that manages WatchConnectivity session, handles messaging, activation, and incoming message processing.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures that the session is activated, delays if necessary.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to the Apple Watch, either immediately if reachable or queued otherwise.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Converts various object representations into a normalized dictionary form.

methods.name: parseActions
methods.description: Parses message payload to extract an array of watch prompt actions.

methods.name: parseNotificationPayload
methods.description: Parses the message payload into a WatchNotifyMessage object, filtering and extracting relevant fields.
